title: Potpie GraphRAG indirect prompt injection — docstring payload to tool execution (potpie-graphrag-prompt-injection, part 1, March 2026)

nodes.attacker_opens_pr_with_payload: Attacker opens a pull request containing an instruction-shaped payload embedded in a docstring/comment — attacker needs only the ability to open a PR (verified directly, ADVISORY.md 'Attack vector' step 1; payload verbatim in honeypot/app/schemas/compliance.py:7-19)
nodes.parsing_no_data_instruction_tag: Root cause (pre-existing platform property, not attacker-supplied): Potpie parses code via tree-sitter + blar-graph and stores the result in Neo4j as a knowledge-graph node with no distinction between code data and system instructions (verified directly, ADVISORY.md 'Root cause' and 'Vulnerability details' steps 2-3)
nodes.graphrag_retrieves_payload: Potpie's agent retrieves the payload-carrying node via the GraphRAG pipeline during ordinary code analysis, with no data/instruction filtering applied at retrieval either (verified directly, ADVISORY.md step 4)
nodes.llm_context_mixed: The LLM receives the payload as part of its context, indistinguishable from legitimate instructions, because nothing upstream tagged it otherwise (verified directly, ADVISORY.md step 5, first half)
nodes.model_executes_directive: The model complies with the embedded directive and issues the corresponding tool call (empirically config-dependent — see SOURCES.md: gpt-4.1-mini did this, claude-sonnet-4-6 refused, in the same test)
nodes.tool_executes_outbound: The agent's `http_fetch` tool executes an outbound GET request to the attacker's OAST domain, permitted by the test harness's own domain allowlist (`*.oast.fun`, `*.interactsh.com`) (verified directly, docs/EVIDENCE.md 'Execution configuration' / 'Test environment')
nodes.injected_instruction_executed: External confirmation that the embedded instruction executed: Interactsh callback received (200 OK, 2026-03-07 09:54 UTC, 3-interaction callback chain) (verified directly, ADVISORY.md 'Proof of concept', docs/EVIDENCE.md 'Callback confirmation')

_note_for_reader:
The graph is built from ADVISORY.md/docs/EVIDENCE.md of the potpie-graphrag-prompt-injection repository (state: marsakahenry14-lab/potpie-graphrag-prompt-injection @ 7bf76d1, cloned fresh 2026-08-05). Affected version — potpie-ai/potpie's pre-v2.0.0 architecture, March 2026; this is a HISTORICAL finding, not the current state.

This is a linear chain: each node is necessary for the next, there is no disjunction. With sigma=[], all 6 nodes plus the goal classify as LB — this is expected, not a bug: unlike erc8183-evaluator-integrity and potpie-context-provenance, where the real architecture provides alternative paths, this is a single documented sequential kill chain. The tool honestly finds no scaffolding where none exists.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION from the case's original sketch: model_vulnerable/model_resilient (gpt-4.1-mini vs. claude-sonnet-4-6) and tool_allowlist_permits_oast were originally proposed as Σ substitutions. They are not encoded that way here, for the same reason as the 5-implementation ecosystem check in erc8183-evaluator-integrity: this is a check of whether a node's precondition holds in a SPECIFIC test configuration, not an alternative path to the SAME goal that bypasses the node. Σ answers 'is there another mechanism that does not use this node,' not 'does the precondition hold in this particular run.' See SOURCES.md.

2026-08-05 re-verification: the old pipeline (tree-sitter+blar-graph → Neo4j with no DATA/INSTRUCTION tag) is confirmed absent from current potpie-ai/potpie (0 hits for 'blar-graph' in a repository-wide search; parsing moved to a new Rust module, potpie/parsing/). This is not a disproof — ADVISORY.md itself states a pre-v2.0.0 scope. The same invariant (missing provenance/trust) was reopened in the new architecture and independently confirmed in cases/potpie-context-provenance (schema_no_trust_field, LB core).
